facts.business: Choksi Asia Limited is an integrated provider of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) radiography and radiation shielding solutions, engaged in processing, distribution, and trading of industrial X-ray films, lead screens, chemicals, X-ray generators, radiography cameras, radioactive sources, and radiation shielding materials.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on fixed assets, including capital advances

auditor.name: KARIA & SHAH
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Litigation Matter - Claims against company not acknowledged as Debt. Contingent liability reported in notes accompanying financial statements is on account of order passed by Commissioner of Customs for the levy of SAD & penalty thereon amounting to Rs 15.74 crores and further penalty on executives/director of the company amounting to Rs 75 lacs. The Company has filed an appeal before the Honorable Tribunal of Customs against the said order and management is expecting a favorable order based on the legal advisory's opinion.

key_risks: Litigation Matter - Claims against company not acknowledged as Debt: Contingent liability on account of order passed by Commissioner of Customs for the levy of SAD & penalty thereon amounting to Rs 15.74 crores and further penalty on executives/director of the company amounting to Rs 75 lacs.
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for Related Party Transactions with Mr. Samir Choksi (Managing Director) for an aggregate value not exceeding Rs. 15 crores during the period from the 34th AGM up to the date of the 35th AGM to be held in FY 2027-28, to be carried out at arm's length basis and in the ordinary course of business.
